description: Declarative venue-access probe for Clean-Slate Night City. Compiled by tools/build-clean-slate.py into mod\neon_ascendancy\venue_probe.questphase and wired off ascendancy.questphase behind the dev fact na_dev_venue_probe > 0 (set only by NeonAscendancy_ApplyDevDebug). Each entry declares a venue's quest prefab, the door device actions that open it, and any community spawner activations. Venue phases carry prefabs, doors and communities ONLY - never journal, mappin, phone or street-story/gig phases (enforced by the builder). See docs/research/world-access.md section 4.2 Layer 1 and section 5.

gate.why: Dormant unless DevDebug sets it. Keeps the whole probe out of normal play while allowing a single in-game test of prefab instantiation, door power/open state and community spawning.

keep_alive_pause.why: Never set during normal play; keeps venue_probe.questphase alive so its phasePrefabs stay instantiated for the whole test session.

venues.why: The six EP1 fast-travel dataterms are inside combat_zone_data_terminals_prefabLN6J6KI, which the Dogtown exterior sectors only stream when the streaming variant combat_zone_data_terminals_active is shown (default: _deactive). Declares that prefab and swaps the variant so the dataterm devices exist; the dataterm PS then accepts fast travel once powered (a dataterm offers nothing while IsUnpowered/IsDisabled).

notes.summary: Dogtown vendors (stadium market + container_zone/monument_av/hillpark/high_peak/boulevard_av) are ep1\openworld\vendors\ep1_vendors.questphase, which our archive does NOT load. Its sub-phases are gated on ep1_side_content >= 1, and stadium additionally on q301_02_active > 0; each vendor zone also needs its *_default_on fact (e.g. cz_stadium_gunsmith_01_default_on) and models vendors as questSpawnSet/questCommunityTemplate nodes inside the location prefabs, not as questPrefabs of the vendor phase. Populating them therefore needs facts set at runtime (DevDebug), which the facts policy keeps out of the archive. Spawner refs verified in the phase: stadium #cz_stadium_black_market_01, _clothing_01, _food_01..03, _gunsmith_01, _junk_01, _medic_01, _netrunner_01, _ripperdoc_01 (entryName=<name>, phase A/None); container_zone #cz_con_{clothingshop,foodshop,gunsmith,junkshop,medicstore,ripdoc}_01; monument_av #cz_monument_av_ripperdoc_anderson, #farida; communities #cz_stadium_clothing_01_tommie_walker_com, #cz_stadium_ws_vendor_06_robot_com.

Afterlife back-room door (owner look-at id 17830752525230996744, app=doors_single_entropy_j, pos=(-1430.8,986.5,16.5), locked=true) is an anonymous/base-world door device; its authored ref was not resolvable from the offline extracts, so no unverified ref was added. Dexter: vanilla spawns him via questSpawnSet #dex entry='dex' phase='q005_afterlife_default' in q005_01_plan, which declares only #q005_pr_afterlife (no story prefab needed). His seat workspot #q005_ws_dex_afterlife_01 lives under the #q005_cin_01_plan sub-prefab INSIDE #q005_pr_afterlife, so declaring #q005_pr_afterlife in the cast layer and activating #dex/dex/q005_afterlife_default is enough to seat him with no scene/dialogue. Options if the cinematics sub-prefab is a problem: (a) declare #q005_pr_afterlife and spawn #dex as above; (b) use #q005_ws_dex_limo_afterlife (outside the cin prefab) instead.
